change_scope: OS sidecar file locks around file-authority reads, compare-and-save and readback in nine domain stores, plus AtomicFilePersistence replacement/recovery/deletion. Thirteen changed/new sources since previous development checkpoint, including updated stopped-treasury test.

patch.apply_after: checkpoint20; replaces every earlier development patch; do not stack

fresh_compile.scope: All cumulative changed production and selected test sources compiled into empty output directories. Dependencies and unchanged classes retained; not full clean Core.

tests.mode: Disjoint 128 MiB in-process Maven batches. Joint/admission and prior-regression batches overlapped in time; all other batches ran sequentially. Child probes use 64 MiB JVMs.
tests.process_scope: Nine actual file-backed domain CAS races using two independent JVMs and a third fresh reader: nation, territory, treasury, city, diplomacy, bilateral alliance, military alliance, federation, war. Competing commits and fresh reads block behind the OS lock. Killed owner, killed unfinished atomic replacement, confirmed snapshot surviving termination, delete contention, reentrant aliases, interrupted waiter, failed sidecar open. No Bukkit host and no mocked storage in child probes.
tests.limits: Windows local filesystem only. Process termination probes cover storage boundaries, not the complete NationModule disband lifecycle. No multi-process SQL/MySQL, network-filesystem or mixed-version writer proof. Other gameplay stores still need business-level stale-snapshot/receipt protocols.

found_and_fixed: Original compare/replace guards only serialized threads in one JVM. Cooperating processes now lock a stable sidecar for the entire protected operation.
Original recovery/delete could remove another live writer temporary file. All three AtomicFilePersistence operations now use the same process lock.
Child harness changed from redirected log files to drained pipes to avoid Windows handle cleanup delays; fresh-reader probes no longer compute a new conflicting retirement.

Extended regression found an old treasury lifecycle assertion that queried a stopped service. It now verifies both that delayed refresh did not alter balances and that stopped-service access is rejected. Initial batch also skipped two environment-gated MySQL tests, which remain explicitly outside final local selections.
operational_constraints: Keep .lock sidecars stable; do not delete or replace them while any cooperating writer may run. OS lock ownership, not file existence, determines whether a writer is active.
Stop old-version writers and both backend writers during migration. This change does not implement live file-to-SQL backend switching.
Only specified nine authority adapters protect business compare/save. Atomic file replacement locking alone does not prevent another caller from writing a stale business snapshot.

Busy/unsupported/interrupted acquisition fails closed with a five-second local/native lock-wait budget; target-file/sidecar symbolic links are rejected. Parent path is canonicalized; filesystem IO may take longer, hard-link aliasing and external directory/sidecar replacement are outside the protocol.
known_open: Complete disband-process kill/restart and SQL multi-process/MySQL validation remain pending; no claim of all-Core multi-server gameplay safety.
Declaration fees remain separate ordinary treasury debit/refund; the admission fence prevents new war state, not a durable fee transaction.
Ordinary alliance/diplomacy transitions and treaty political/territory/army receiver effects need original-operation receipts.
Old standalone journals/no-receipt transactions need independent evidence. Pending disband/payment safe cancellation and old-account reconciliation are not provided.
